identity_contract: species/ion, source-qualified lower and upper configuration/term/J/parity, energy origin, wavelength medium/frame, isotope/HFS/component identity; no wavelength-only matching

methods.primary: GRASP MCDHF then RCI; pinned source, compiler, libraries, every input/output and executable hash
methods.independent: MCHF plus Breit-Pauli/CI where needed; native modern biorthogonal application reproduces upstream Si E2 reference bytes and yields an exploratory O I E1 result through a value-preserving layout exporter. Converged O models remain owed.
methods.shared_ancestry_caveat: Both implementations share development lineage; method agreement is not independent experimental validation
methods.existing_comparators: Tachiev/Froese Fischer 2002, Li et al. 2023 and existing ASD/AGSS21 values are exposed theoretical/evaluated diagnostics, never the withheld experimental set

calculation_design_for_review.reference_configurations: Start with source-justified O I even 2s2 2p4 and 2s2 2p3 np; odd 2s2 2p3 ns/nd. Specify every additional reference and target ASF explicitly before freeze.
calculation_design_for_review.active_spaces: Exploratory nested n=3 spd, n=4 spdf, n=5 spdfg; valence SD from fixed 1s2 2s2 occupations. Starting spectroscopic orbitals retained from v10; frozen n<3 radial functions; optimize n=3 then new layer only. EOL target ordinals odd J2=1, even J1=2/J2=3/J3=1 verified by native leading LS composition. This limited VV sequence does not replace core-valence, radial-grid, Hamiltonian or independent-method studies.
calculation_design_for_review.optimization: Freeze EOL/EAL weights, target ASFs, orbital optimization/frozen sets, radial grid, SCF controls and state tracking before reveal. Track LS composition across avoided crossings.
calculation_design_for_review.relativistic: Separate Dirac-Coulomb, Breit and QED sensitivity runs, and the independent Breit-Pauli approximation; agreement of labels does not equate Hamiltonians.
calculation_design_for_review.gauges: Record Babushkin/length and Coulomb/velocity with native energy and line-strength convention; gauge_fraction=abs(A_B-A_C)/max(A_B,A_C). This is a diagnostic, not a calibrated sigma.
calculation_design_for_review.observed_energies: Native predictions and any observed-level substitution are separate records. Preserve original and substituted energy source; scaling follows multipole/operator convention and is never silently applied to both gauges.
calculation_design_for_review.lifetimes_branching: Require complete downward decay inventory for each upper level, including intercombination and applicable other multipoles. The three current E1 rows do not establish complete lifetimes or branching fractions.
calculation_design_for_review.uncertainty: Predeclare an uncertainty model from convergence, independent method, neglected physics and calibration data; retain multiplet/common-scale covariance. No sigma from gauge spread alone and no invented confidence for NIST letters.

blindness.partition: Group all transitions sharing an upper lifetime, branching normalization, multiplet or experimental scale into the same partition. Do not split components across training/calibration/holdout.
blindness.exposure: Existing source tables, literature comparison tables and all numerical exploratory outputs are exposed. Record prior knowledge. If no genuinely unexposed data exist, report a preregistered external validation rather than calling it blind.
sequence: curator verifies primary experimental method, uncertainties, covariance, identity and independence
curator commits the sealed benchmark bytes/hash and independent witness before model choices freeze
scientific reviewer approves scope, methods, uncertainty model, thresholds and split
freeze model inputs, code/binaries and calculation manifests
run and freeze all predictions and failure ledgers before reveal
curator reveals the original byte-identical benchmark
score all preregistered rows, preserve failures and exclusions without retuning
review calibration and systematic covariance; any changed model starts a new version and new independent test

forbidden_lines: Native M1 and E2 reference-configuration outputs now exist in coverage_v8. Same-basis duplicate f1/f2 records must not be summed. Large E2 gauge disagreements prevent accuracy/adoption claims; convergence, mixing and independent O checks remain owed.
stellar_connection: Atomic gf candidates do not validate the O Bridge atom, collisions, photoionization, NLTE, atmosphere, Solar abundance, damping or telluric correction. IR stellar publication remains exact-holding telluric-verified and RYA-587 gated.
